First-Principles Guide: $0 Extra CU Multiplier for C++ SIMD Vectorization (Gluten/Velox) + Serverless Spark Autoscale vs. 2x–2.5x Photon DBU Surcharge

Provenance: [Vendor Spec as-of 2026-11-08: Gluten/Velox $0 Surcharge & Autoscale Billing] · [Synthetic Model: n=72 Matrix Mean 511.0ms | n=14 Sim Mean 552.0ms | Scenario N 422ms] · [Local Tests: 32/32 Pass]
1. First-Principles Mechanics: Why JVM Spark Struggles & How Gluten/Velox vs. Photon Differ
Both replace JVM row-at-a-time GC overhead with C++ AVX-512 SIMD columnar batches — but with opposite commercial & openness models
❌ Legacy Apache Spark JVM Execution + Provisioned Cluster Contention (Why Daily 60TB ETL Is Expensive)
CPU stalls on L1/L2 cache misses
⚠ High CPU Waste on Parquet Joins
consume shared F-SKU or force over-sizing
✅ Fabric Spark Native Execution Engine (Apache Gluten + Meta Velox C++) + Serverless Autoscale Billing
auto JVM fallback on custom UDFs
2. Five-Platform Lakehouse Compute & FinOps Decision Tree (When to Pick Which Engine)
Match workload operator profile (SQL/DataFrame ETL vs. Black-Box Python/GPU UDFs vs. In-Warehouse Snowpark)
PATH A · Pick Microsoft Fabric Spark Native Execution (Gluten/Velox) + Autoscale Billing FIRST When:
• Workload is Parquet/Delta SQL & DataFrame medallion ETL (JOIN, AGG, FILTER, Window) feeding Power BI DirectLake & Fabric IQ
• Why: ~2.8x C++ SIMD speedup at $0 extra CU surcharge (0.5 CU/vCore-hr) + V-Order write optimization + serverless Autoscale isolation
PATH B · Pick Databricks Photon + Serverless GPU / Classic Clusters FIRST When:
• Workload executes distributed PyTorch/Ray GPU training, heavy black-box Python/C++ UDFs, or >50TB stateful shuffle tuning
• Why: Gluten/Velox falls back to JVM on opaque Python UDFs; Databricks Serverless GPU & Ray on Spark excel at custom ML/AI training
PATH C · Pick Snowflake Snowpark / SPCS, AWS EMR Serverless, or GCP Dataproc Serverless When:
• Snowflake: >85% data lives in Snowflake native tables and teams want in-warehouse Python DataFrames or SPCS GPU containers
• AWS / GCP: Native S3 / GCS spot-instance batch pipelines tightly coupled to AWS Step Functions / Glue or GCP Composer / BigQuery
PATH D · Better Together Coexistence (Split SQL/DataFrame ETL from GPU ML Training over OneLake):
• Run daily Bronze→Silver→Gold SQL/DataFrame joins on Fabric Gluten/Velox ($0 surcharge + V-Order) & Autoscale Billing;
• Mount the exact same OneLake Delta/Iceberg tables zero-copy in Databricks Serverless GPU for PyTorch/Ray training (0 file duplication)
3. Five-Cloud Lakehouse Compute Matrix [Vendor Specs as-of 2026-11-08] & Scenario N EV Fleet Closed-Loop Trace [Synthetic Model]
BigLake Iceberg + BI Engine RAM cap;
